title: Inverse probability of censoring weights for informative dropout
summary: A trial's risk difference when sicker patients drop out more in one arm, by weighting completers by the inverse probability of staying, with a stacked-sandwich standard error.

sizing._note: Sized as the two-arm comparison, inflated for expected dropout; weighting costs some precision beyond that.

pinned_defaults: Both: a logistic model for staying given arm, the prognostic factor and their interaction; completers weighted by 1 / P(stayed); each arm's weighted (Hajek) risk.
Both: SE from the stacked equations (the dropout model's score and the two weighted risks); the weights-as-known SE is reported beside it.
_assumption: Missing at random given arm and the modelled factors: no unmeasured cause of both dropout and outcome.
